trap.label: pronome extra
trap.wrong: The book that I bought it is good.
trap.right: The book that I bought is good.
trap.why: Em português é comum repetir o pronome ('o livro que comprei ele'); em inglês o objeto da oração relativa se omite.

mcq.q: The film ___ I saw was great.
The woman ___ called me is my aunt.
The house ___ I live in is old.

opts: The man I met is kind.
The man who I met him is kind.
The man I met him is kind.

fix.wrong: The cake that I made it is good.
fix.right: The cake that I made is good.

fix.wrong: The man which lives here is kind.
fix.right: The man who lives here is kind.

fix.wrong: A hotel is a place who people stay.
fix.right: A hotel is a place where people stay.

rewrite.prompt: Junte: “The cake is good. I made it.” com that
rewrite.answer: The cake that I made is good.

rewrite.prompt: Junte: “The man is kind. He lives here.” com who
rewrite.answer: The man who lives here is kind.

rewrite.prompt: Junte: “A hotel is a place. People stay there.” com where
rewrite.answer: A hotel is a place where people stay.
